resources.string: On-device nudity filter. Nothing leaves your phone.
Scene-change guard (pixelate on sudden cuts / fast scroll)

Tip: in the capture dialog choose \"A single app\" and pick the app you want filtered. Then Veil\'s own censor boxes are not captured, which gives the most stable and fastest filtering. \"Entire screen\" works too but is less reliable.
Apps that block screenshots (incognito tabs, Netflix, banking) appear black to Veil and cannot be filtered. On Android 15+ protection stops when the screen locks; start it again after unlocking.
Veil needs permission to display over other apps.
